note: Edited wording of the steps (tools/step_text.py), only what was edited; applied when guide.py is run. key: the step's text_key in steps.json.

steps.caption: Remove T1 from both T2 pieces.
Slide the top T2 off the bottom T2.
Remove the second T2 from T1.
Disconnect the USB Cable from the Nano Board.
Disconnect the Servo Extension Wire from Row 10.
Disconnect the Shoulder Servo (White Dot) from Row 9.
Disconnect the Elbow Servo (Black Dot) from Row 6.
Remove the Servo Extension Wire from the hook-shaped slot in R4.
Disconnect the Servo Extension Wire from the Claw Servo's wires.
steps.caution: When disconnecting the wires, pull apart the two black connectors. Do not pull on the wires themselves.

steps.caption: Thread the Claw Servo's wires out of the bottom square hole in A6.
Thread the Claw Servo's wires out of the top square hole in A6.
Remove the two 6mm screws connecting A12 and A13 to C1.
Remove the 6mm screw connecting A5 to C2.
Slide the claw out from between A5 on one side and A12 and A13 on the other.
Remove the 10mm screw connecting C6 to C9.
Remove C9 from the latches of C1 and C2.
Remove C7 from the servo horn.
Remove the two 16mm screws connecting C6 to C3.
Remove C6 from the latches of C1 and C2.
Slide C4 and C5 toward the bottom of C3, then lift them out of the slots.
Remove C1 and C2 from the slots in C3.
Thread the Claw Servo's wires out of the hole at the top of C3.
Remove the Claw Servo (Blue Dot) from C3.
Remove the 6mm screw connecting A12 to A10, then separate the pieces.
Remove the 10mm screw connecting A13 to A10, then separate the pieces.
Remove the 6mm screw connecting R6 to A11.
Remove A10 and A11 from R6.
Remove the 6mm screw connecting A11 to A10, then separate the pieces.
Remove the Shoulder Servo's wires from the hook-shaped slot in R6.
Remove the two 10mm screws connecting R7 to R6.
Remove R7 from the Shoulder Servo (White Dot).
steps.caution: Carefully thread the Shoulder Servo's wires all the way out of R7.

steps.caption: Tilt the Shoulder Servo (White Dot) to guide it out of R6.
Remove the 6mm screw connecting A5 to A7 and the 10mm screw connecting A1 - A3 to A4.
Remove A4 and A5 together from A1 and A7.
Remove the 6mm screw connecting A5 to A4, then separate the pieces.
Remove the Elbow Servo's wires from the hook-shaped slot in R5.
Remove the two 10mm screws connecting R8 to R5.
Remove R8 from the Elbow Servo (Black Dot).
steps.caution: Carefully thread the Elbow Servo's wires all the way out of R8.

steps.caption: Tilt the Elbow Servo (Black Dot) to guide it out of R5.
Slide A1 - A3 up and out from between R5 and A7.
Remove the 10mm screw connecting A1, A2, and A3. Then, separate the pieces.
Remove the 6mm screw connecting A7 to R2.
Remove A6 - A9 from R2.
Remove the 16mm screw connecting A8 to A9.
Remove A9 from the cross-shaped slot next to A8.
Remove A8 from A6.
Remove the 16mm screw connecting A7 to A9.
Remove A9 from the cross-shaped slot next to A7.
Remove A7 from A6.
Disconnect the Base Servo (No Dot) from Row 5.
Remove B8 from B5, B6, and B7.
Disconnect all eight breadboard wires from the joysticks and the Nano I/O Module.
Lift the Nano I/O Module over the notch in B4, then slide it out of the slots in both B6 pieces.
Remove the Nano Board from the Nano I/O Module.
steps.caution: Use the Pry Tool to carefully remove the Nano Board.

steps.caption: Remove B6, B7, and the Right Joystick together from B3 and B4.
Remove B7 from the Right Joystick.
Remove the Right Joystick from B6.
Remove B5, B6, and the Left Joystick together from B3 and B4.
Remove B6 from the Left Joystick.
Remove the Left Joystick from B5.
Remove B4 from the center slot in B2.
Remove B3 from the slots in B2.
Remove the six 6mm screws connecting B1 and B2.
Remove B1 from B2.
Slide B2 out from under the servo horn.
Remove the Base Servo's wires from the hook-shaped slot in R4.
Remove R6 from R3 and R4.
Remove R5 from R3 and R4.
Remove R4 from R1.
Remove R3 from R1.
Remove R2 from the Base Servo (No Dot).
Tilt the Base Servo (No Dot) to guide it out of R1.
